request_text: I would like a copy of everything you hold about me, in a file I can open. To be clear, this is not a deletion request: do not erase or close anything, I am still a customer.
Please erase my personal data. I understand that a reference may stay behind for records you must keep, as long as my name, email and phone are gone from it.
Close my account and delete my personal data. Keep whatever the security retention period still requires.
I asked for deletion earlier and the status says it is done. Please check every copy, including any replica or reporting database, and tell me what is left.
My deletion was reported as complete. Confirm that nothing is still copying my data to another system.
